asset_id: quaternius_adventurer
category: characters (animation source)
description: Rigged + animated low-poly adventurer from Quaternius's Ultimate Modular Characters (62-bone humanoid rig
             with fingers; Idle, Idle_Neutral, Walk, Run, Wave, Interact, Roll, ... 24 takes). Only the skeleton motion
             is used: selected takes (Interact, Idle_Neutral) are retargeted onto the chibi cast skeleton
             (Tools/dai/chibi/retarget.py); the adventurer mesh itself is not exported.
